about: The one palette source for batlog. Every colour and terminal style a surface paints is a token here, with its role. brand/check (make brand-check) fails when a surface's value drifts from its token, when a file paints a colour that maps to no token, when a mapped name disappears, or when a docs line names a token with a different value. Exceptions live in "unchecked", each with its reason. How to change a colour: docs/reference/brand.md.

ink.role: Battery Ink, the identity colour: the mark, wordmark and lockups on light surfaces, and the dark app tile. The median of the supplied artwork's dark pixels.

white.role: Reverse artwork on dark surfaces (the README lockup in dark mode), the mark on the dark app tile, the light app tile, and guide pages.

black.role: The strict one-colour variant, for print and stamps.

cyan.role: Signal Cyan, the optional accent: the cyan mark and lockup, and the clear-space line in the guide. Never a terminal colour and never a live battery status.

mist.role: Panels behind artwork in the guide PDF and the overview.

muted.role: Secondary text in the guide PDF and the overview.

swatch-edge.role: The outline around colour swatches in the overview, so the white swatch shows.

battery.role: batlog ui: battery % while awake on battery. ANSI cyan, so the user's terminal theme decides the actual colour.

charging.role: batlog ui: battery % on AC. ANSI green.

cursor.role: batlog ui: the chart cursor's column. ANSI yellow.

warn.role: batlog ui: warnings. ANSI yellow, the same as the cursor.

problem.role: Problems: batlog ui's errors and the CLI's 'service recommended' battery condition. ANSI red.

secondary.role: batlog ui: asleep columns and secondary text. Faint, not a colour, so it works on any theme.

title.role: batlog ui: box titles, including the 'batlog' sidebar title. Bold in the terminal's own font.

selected.role: batlog ui: the selected row. Reverse video, so it follows the theme.

internal/ui/style.go.about: batlog ui's styles: one per role, plain when colour is off (NO_COLOR, TERM=dumb, not a terminal). The keys are newStyles' fields.

cmd/health.go.about: batlog health paints one escape code: the battery condition in red when it needs service.

unchecked.reason: Tests and their expectations: they assert escape codes and colours on purpose, and never reach a user.
The check itself: its parser and its mutation tests name example colours on purpose.
